Cosign signing overview (WebFetch summary): "Signing events are logged in Rekor, a signature transparency log, providing an auditable record"; "The entry in Rekor's immutable transparency log means that the signer will be monitoring the log ... will know if there is an unexpected signing event." Supports "kept, not rewritten"; what the page says can be noticed is an unexpected signing event, not a later change.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: A transparency log, where Cosign records signing events, rests on a related idea: a public record that is kept, not rewritten, so anyone watching it can notice an entry that should not be there.
